notes: NDM 1.9.0 — the full IDM-parity release. Every function of the app and the browser extension was audited against IDM one by one, in code and in live use: 75 divergences and hidden bugs are fixed, and the six IDM features that were still missing are now built — Site Grabber with a 4-step wizard and saveable projects (explore levels, whole-site mode, extension and size filters, subfolder routing), the Site Logins manager (saved logins apply automatically to matching sites), full proxy settings (system proxy, PAC, or manual with authentication and per-protocol HTTP/HTTPS/FTP switches), customizable toolbar and download-list columns, turn off / restart the PC when downloads complete (globally, per queue, or per download), and the download list refreshing in place every 200 ms. Also restored: the pause-resume progress loop, fresh-engine retries for failed downloads (permanent 404/410 excluded), browser downloads removed only after NDM confirms it took them, HLS videos paired with their audio before finishing, a truly per-download speed limiter, the drop basket, a categories editor, the scheduler Files tab and the row context menu.
